ROUTINE_DEFINITION:
BEGIN
    DECLARE v_payrollId INT;
    DECLARE v_riderNetPay DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
    DECLARE v_totalEarnings DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
    DECLARE v_totalExpenses DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
    DECLARE v_totalEMI DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
    DECLARE v_monthEnd DATE;
    DECLARE v_errno INT;

    DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
    BEGIN
        GET DIAGNOSTICS CONDITION 1 
            v_errno = MYSQL_ERRNO, 
            p_errorMessage = MESSAGE_TEXT;
        
        ROLLBACK;
        
        INSERT INTO PayrollErrorLog (
            procedureName,
            riderId,
            companyId,
            payMonth,
            errorMessage,
            errorCode,
            createdAt
        )
        VALUES (
            'sp_process_rider_payroll',
            p_riderId,
            p_companyId,
            p_payMonth,
            p_errorMessage,
            v_errno,
            NOW()
        );
        
        SET p_success = 0;
        SET p_payrollId = NULL;
        SET p_netPay = 0;
    END;

    proc_body: BEGIN
        /* ================= INITIALIZATION ================= */
        SET v_monthEnd = LAST_DAY(p_payMonth);
        SET p_success = 0;
        SET p_errorMessage = NULL;
        
        START TRANSACTION;

        /* ================= PAYROLL HEADER ================= */
        INSERT INTO Payroll (
            payMonth,
            riderId,
            riderName,
            isFullTime,
            clientId,
            clientUserId,
            clientName,
            vehicleId,
            vehicleNumber,
            companyId,
            companyCode,
            companyName,
            iznamalSalary,
            createdAt,
            createdBy
        )
        SELECT 
            p_payMonth,
            r.riderId,
            r.riderName,
            CASE WHEN cu.riderId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isFullTime,
            cl.clientId,
            cu.clientUserId,
            cl.clientName,
            IFNULL(v.vehicleId, 'Un-assigned'),
            IFNULL(v.vehicleNumber, 'Un-assigned'),
            c.companyId,
            c.code,
            c.name,
            r.iznamalSalary,
            NOW(),
            p_createdBy
        FROM Rider r
        JOIN Company c ON c.companyId = r.companyId
        JOIN ClientUserId cu ON cu.riderId = r.riderId
        JOIN Client cl ON cl.clientId = cu.clientId
        LEFT JOIN RiderVehicleConfig rvc ON rvc.riderId = r.riderId AND rvc.status = 1
        LEFT JOIN Vehicle v ON v.vehicleId = rvc.vehicleId
        WHERE r.riderId = p_riderId;

        IF ROW_COUNT() = 0 THEN
            INSERT INTO PayrollErrorLog (
                procedureName,
                riderId,
                companyId,
                payMonth,
                errorMessage,
                createdAt
            )
            VALUES (
                'sp_generate_single_rider_payroll',
                p_riderId,
                p_companyId,
                p_payMonth,
                'Rider not found or missing client mapping',
                NOW()
            );
            LEAVE proc_body;
        END IF;

        SET v_payrollId = LAST_INSERT_ID();

        IF v_payrollId IS NULL OR v_payrollId = 0 THEN
            SET p_errorMessage = 'Failed to create payroll header';
            SET p_success = 0;
            ROLLBACK;
            LEAVE proc_body;
        END IF;

        /* ================= EARNINGS ================= */
        INSERT INTO PayrollEarnings (
            payrollId,
            singleOrderCount,
            doubleOrderCount,
            singleOrderRate,
            doubleOrderRate,
            batchNo
        )
        SELECT 
            v_payrollId,
            SUM(ro.singleOrder),
            SUM(ro.doubleOrder),
            ov.singleOrderValue,
            ov.doubleOrderValue,
            ro.batchNo
        FROM RiderOrder ro
        INNER JOIN Batch b ON b.batchNo = ro.batchNo
        INNER JOIN OrderValue ov ON ov.clientId = ro.clientId 
            AND ov.batchVehicleCategoryId = ro.batchVehicleCategoryId and ov.batchId = b.batchId 
        WHERE ro.riderId = p_riderId
            AND ro.orderMonth = p_payMonth
        GROUP BY ro.batchNo, ro.batchVehicleCategoryId;

        UPDATE Payroll
        SET grossEarnings = (
            SELECT IFNULL(
                SUM((singleOrderCount * singleOrderRate) + (doubleOrderCount * doubleOrderRate)),
                0
            )
            FROM PayrollEarnings
            WHERE payrollId = v_payrollId
        )
        WHERE payrollId = v_payrollId;

        SELECT grossEarnings 
        INTO v_totalEarnings
        FROM Payroll
        WHERE payrollId = v_payrollId;

        /* ================= EXPENSES ================= */
        INSERT INTO PayrollExpenses (
            payrollId,
            trafficFines,
            adminFees,
            processingFees,
            garageBills,
            maroorFines,
            previousBalances,
            dgDeduction,
            salesCash,
            incentives,
            extras,
            mobileBills
        )
        SELECT 
            v_payrollId,
            r.trafficFines,
            r.adminFees,
            r.processingFees,
            r.garageBills,
            r.maroorFines,
            r.previousBalances,
            r.dgDeduction,
            IFNULL(s.pendingDues, 0),
            r.incentives,
            r.advances + r.akamaRenewalAmount + r.miscellaneousExpenses,
            r.mobileBills
        FROM Rider r
        LEFT JOIN SalesCashDetails s ON s.riderId = r.riderId 
            AND s.entryDate = v_monthEnd
        WHERE r.riderId = p_riderId;

        SELECT IFNULL(
            trafficFines + adminFees + processingFees + garageBills + 
            maroorFines + previousBalances + dgDeduction + salesCash + 
            extras + mobileBills - incentives,
            0
        )
        INTO v_totalExpenses
        FROM PayrollExpenses
        WHERE payrollId = v_payrollId;

        UPDATE Payroll
        SET totalExpenses = v_totalExpenses
        WHERE payrollId = v_payrollId;

        /* ================= EMI ================= */
        INSERT INTO PayrollVehicleEMI (
            payrollId,
            vehicleId,
            isEmiSkipped,
            emiMonth,
            principalAmount,
            interestRate,
            monthlyEmi,
            remainingBalance
        )
        SELECT 
            v_payrollId,
            vehicleId,
            isEmiSkipped,
            p_payMonth,
            principalAmount,
            interestRate,
            monthlyEmi,
            totalPayable - totalPaid
        FROM CarEmi
        WHERE riderId = p_riderId
            AND isActive = 1
            AND contractStartDate >= DATE_FORMAT(p_payMonth, '%Y-%m-01')
            AND contractStartDate <= v_monthEnd;

        SELECT IFNULL(
            SUM(CASE WHEN isEmiSkipped = 0 THEN monthlyEmi ELSE 0 END),
            0
        )
        INTO v_totalEMI
        FROM PayrollVehicleEMI
        WHERE payrollId = v_payrollId;

        UPDATE CarEmi
        SET 
            totalPaid = CASE 
                WHEN isEmiSkipped = 1 THEN totalPaid 
                ELSE totalPaid + monthlyEmi 
            END,
            isActive = CASE 
                WHEN (CASE WHEN isEmiSkipped = 1 THEN totalPaid ELSE totalPaid + monthlyEmi END) >= totalPayable 
                THEN 0 
                ELSE isActive 
            END,
            monthlyEmi = CASE 
                WHEN monthlyEmi >= totalPayable - totalPaid 
                THEN totalPayable - totalPaid 
                ELSE monthlyEmi 
            END,
            isEmiSkipped = 0,
            skipCount = skipCount + CASE WHEN isEmiSkipped = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        WHERE riderId = p_riderId
            AND isActive = 1;

		UPDATE Rider
		SET previousBalances =
		    CASE
		        WHEN v_totalEarnings - v_totalExpenses < 0
		            THEN ABS(v_totalEarnings - v_totalExpenses)
		        ELSE 0
		    END
		WHERE riderId = p_riderId;


        UPDATE Rider
        SET 
            trafficFines = 0,
            adminFees = 0,
            processingFees = 0,
            garageBills = 0,
            maroorFines = 0,
            dgDeduction = 0,
            incentives = 0,
            advances = 0,
            akamaRenewalAmount = 0,
            miscellaneousExpenses = 0
        WHERE riderId = p_riderId;

        /* ================= NET PAY CALCULATION ================= */
        SET v_riderNetPay = v_totalEarnings - v_totalExpenses - v_totalEMI;

        COMMIT;

        /* ================= OUTPUT PARAMETERS ================= */
        SET p_payrollId = v_payrollId;
        SET p_netPay = v_riderNetPay;
        SET p_success = 1;

    END proc_body;
END
